question: What ritual purposes are served by trees linked to lunar mansions?
premises: Trees are linked with the respective lunar mansions
Such trees are used for peace and related rites
inference: Nakṣatra-correlated trees are prescribed for śāntika and similar rituals
uncertainties: The full range of rites included by ādikam is unspecified
plain_english: With these trees connected to the lunar mansions, rites of peace and so forth are performed.
